name: Can BIM track changes throughout a project's lifecycle?

mainEntity.name: Can BIM track changes throughout a project's lifecycle?

acceptedAnswer.text: BIM serves as a "single source of truth," logging all revisions with timestamps and authorship, enabling as-built documentation and future maintenance or renovation planning. autodesk​
